text: Machine learning is a way for computers to learn from data without being told exactly what to do. In supervised learning, a computer studies training data that already has correct answers. From this data, it builds a model, which is like a set of rules it has learned. Later, the model can make predictions about new information it has never seen before. For example, it might predict whether an email is spam or not. The quality of these predictions is measured by accuracy. If the model is correct most of the time, we say it has high accuracy.
